json_schema.title: network.ip_addrs
json_schema.description: Returns a list of IPv4 addresses assigned to the host. 127.0.0.1 is ignored, unless 'include_loopback=True' is indicated. If 'interface' is provided, then only IP addresses from that interface will be returned. Providing a CIDR via 'cidr="10.0.0.0/8"' will return only the addresses which are within that subnet. If 'type' is 'public', then only public addresses will be returned. Ditto for 'type'='private'

include_loopback.ui:title: Include Loopback
include_loopback.ui:description: Toggle to include loopback addresses such as 127.0.0.1 in the output

cidr.ui:title: CIDR
cidr.ui:description: Filter returned addresses to this network (e.g. 10.0.0.0/24 or /24 for mask-only)
